samples.question: A horizontal track of five slot boxes is shown, read left to right as slot 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. A red marker sits in one box and an orange ring surrounds that box; it marks the START slot. Four operator boxes are read left to right; each holds one colored disk. A green disk advances the tracked register one slot to the right (+1), a blue disk retreats it one slot to the left (-1). The register BOUNCES elastically off both walls: a rightward step taken at the right wall (slot 5) reflects back to slot 4, and a leftward step taken at the left wall (slot 1) reflects back to slot 2. The register is never shown after its start. Replaying the operators in order from the ringed start, bouncing at the walls, what is the FINAL slot of the tracked register? Answer exactly 'slot 1' through 'slot 5'.
